notes: Single source of truth for OTA path rules (docs/OTA.md). Mirrored by scripts/ota/ota_const.gd; a test keeps the 'protected' section identical.
Matching is case-sensitive on a root-relative path with '/' separators (no 'res://', no leading './'): exact = whole path, prefixes = begins with, suffixes = ends with.
Category per changed source path (tools/ota/classify.py): not_shipped first, then protected (APK required), then guarded, otherwise safe (default).
A path inside a payload pack is checked against 'protected' and 'guarded' using its raw name AND its source name (pack_aliases: 'x.gd.remap' and 'x.gdc' both map to 'x.gd').
Native-code suffixes are protected anywhere in a pack, a deliberate superset of 'addons/**/*.gdextension|*.so|*.dll|*.dylib'.
